accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.description: Only workspace Owners and Administrators can view billing and subscription configurations.

errorState.title: Could not load billing data
errorState.description: Your balance and usage are unavailable right now, so nothing is shown rather than a figure that could be wrong. {message}
errorState.httpError: The billing service responded with HTTP {status}.

overages.title: Allow overages
overages.descriptionOn: Meetings keep translating past zero credits, up to {cap} credits this cycle.
overages.descriptionOff: Meetings stop the moment the credits run out. Turn this on to let them continue up to the allowance your plan already grants.

currentPlan.label: Current Plan
currentPlan.noBalance: Meetings translate against a credit balance.
currentPlan.cancelled: Cancelled — translation stops {date}. Resubscribe from Manage subscription.

noSubscription.title: No active subscription
noSubscription.description: This workspace has no billing plan yet, so there is no balance or usage to report. Choose a plan to start tracking credits and AI usage.

planPanel.noBalance: Meetings translate against a credit balance.
planPanel.cancelled: Cancelled. Translation stops for this workspace on {date}.
planPanel.doesNotAutoRenew: Does not auto-renew — credits stop on {date}.

manageModal.title: Manage subscription
manageModal.description: The current plan, its cycle, and the settings that change it.
manageModal.cancelledNoRenew: Cancelled — this plan will not renew
manageModal.cancelledNotice: Translation stops for this workspace on {date}. Resubscribe before then to keep it running — the current period is already paid for, so it costs nothing.

toasts.overageOn: Meetings will keep running past zero credits, up to the plan's cap.
toasts.overageOff: Meetings will stop when the credits run out.
toasts.overageFailed: Could not change the overage setting.
toasts.cancelled: Subscription cancelled. It stays active until the period ends.
toasts.reactivated: Renewal is back on. This plan will continue past the current period.

frozen.kept: {credits} credits kept — renew to use them
frozen.keptDetail: Your subscription ended on {date}. These credits are kept for you and come back as soon as you renew.
frozen.dormant: They have been waiting since {date}; they are still yours and still come back when you renew.
frozen.pendingDescription: {credits} credits kept from your previous subscription are being added to this plan.
